[SERVICE DOMAIN: Virtual Account] BIAN Service Landscape V14.0 - vista MATRIX
UBICACION Business Area : Operations and Execution Business Domain : Product Specific Fulfillment Anidado : Loans and Deposits (capacidad de negocio agrupadora, no un nivel del metamodelo)
BUSINESS DEFINITION (proposito) A Virtual Account is a bank account that is defined on an underlying real account. It can receive and send payments for the underlying account while behaving towards the ou tside as a separate account.
METAMODELO Control Record = Asset Type + Generic Artifact Functional Pattern : Fulfill Asset Type : Virtual Account Generic Artifact : Facility Control Record : Virtual Account Facility
